## Appearance

Rowena Calder is a tall young woman who possesses expansive navy eyes and a pale complexion. Her sleek tresses are marked by a dark sheen.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Rowena P19](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0019)_

## History

Rowena Calder is the sister of Ronald Calder and spent the winter in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris) studying music. During a reception at [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), she was noted for her striking appearance and caught the attention of [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), who engaged in conversation with her. Later, a rumor circulated that she had become engaged to Hugh.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Rowena P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Rowena P6](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0006), [v3 ch.Rowena P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Rowena P15](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0015), [v3 ch.Rowena P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), +3 more_
